summary: Russian forces liberated Samoylovka in Zaporizhzhia region while launching massive drone and missile barrages across Ukraine, including deadly strikes on Kharkiv and Berdychiv. Ukraine deployed AI-controlled automatic turrets in Kyiv to counter jet-powered Shahed drones as winter readiness lags at 40%. Russian air defense claimed 343 Ukrainian drones shot down in 24 hours, and a Tu-95 bomber crashed in Amur region killing six crew.
key_points: Russian Vostok group liberated Samoylovka in Zaporizhzhia region, advancing on eastern front. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33734)
Russian strike on Kharkiv high-rise and sewing workshop killed 5 civilians, injured 35. (Source: @eRadarrua/120295)
Russian strike drone hit Berdychiv residential building, damaging floors 4-9, 65 rescuers deployed. (Source: @eRadarrua/120266)
Russian air defense claims 343 Ukrainian drones shot down over Russian regions and Black Sea. (Source: @tass_agency/398898)
Massive Russian drone/missile barrage across 10+ Ukrainian regions using Geran-5, Shahed, Banderoil. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76085)
Ukraine operationalized 12 AI-controlled automatic turrets in Kyiv to intercept jet-powered Shaheds. (Source: @UkraineNow/84488)
Russian strikes destroyed over 500 Ukrainian locomotives since war start, crippling railway logistics. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33736)
Kyiv only 40% winter-ready; defensive lines with 35 rows of barbed wire constructed. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33747, @ukr_leaks_eng/33749)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces liberated Samoylovka in Zaporizhzhia region while launching massive drone and missile barrages across Ukraine, including deadly strikes on Kharkiv and Berdychiv. Ukraine deployed AI-controlled automatic turrets in Kyiv to counter jet-powered Shahed drones as winter readiness lags at 40%. Russian air defense claimed 343 Ukrainian drones shot down in 24 hours, and a Tu-95 bomber crashed in Amur region killing six crew.

points: Ukraine installed 12 AI-controlled automatic turrets in Kyiv using machine guns to intercept jet-powered Shahed drones, with plans for further deployment across the capital. (Source: @UkraineNow/84488)
Ukrainian railway locomotive reserve depleted after Russian strikes destroyed over 500 locomotives since conflict began, per Financial Times reporting. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33736)

Kyiv's winter readiness only 40% complete due to late funding allocation and contractor payments, risking 14-16 hour power outages if energy strikes continue. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33747, @ukr_leaks_eng/33732)
Dense defensive fortifications constructed in Kyiv region including up to 35 rows of barbed wire anticipating potential Russian northern offensive. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33749)
Ukrainian drone activity remains high: Russian MoD claims 343 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over Russian regions and Black Sea in single day. (Source: @tass_agency/398898)
Russian Vostok group of forces liberated Samoylovka village in Zaporizhzhia region, indicating continued offensive operations on eastern front. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33734)
Russian forces conducted strike on Kharkiv residential high-rise and sewing workshop, killing 5 civilians and injuring 35, with rescue operations ongoing. (Source: @eRadarrua/120295)
Russian strike drone attacked Berdychiv, Zhytomyr region, hitting residential building floors 4-9, requiring 17 equipment units and 65 rescuers. (Source: @eRadarrua/120266)

Russian missile and drone barrage launched from multiple directions: Geran-5 missiles from Bryansk, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr; Shahed drones from Sumy, Poltava, Cherkasy, Mykolaiv, Dnipropetrovsk targeting Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Rivne, Kryvyi Rih, Mykolaiv, Odesa, Kropyvnytskyi, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76085, @mon1tor_ua/76082, @mon1tor_ua/76064, @mon1tor_ua/76065, @kpszsu/83066, @kpszsu/83085, @kpszsu/83092, @kpszsu/83115, @eRadarrua/120283, @eRadarrua/120300, @eRadarrua/120336)

Russian strikes targeted energy and port infrastructure: Kochetok electrical substation (Kharkiv), Vilkovo port facility, fuel storage at Chornomorsk port, dry cargo ship in Odesa region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33729)
Russian Tu-95 strategic bomber crashed in Amur region during training, 6 of 7 crew members killed. (Source: @UkraineNow/84496)
Russian air defense claims 343 Ukrainian drones intercepted in 24 hours over Russian territory and Black Sea. (Source: @tass_agency/398898)
Russian Vostok group liberated Samoylovka in Zaporizhzhia region, confirming continued offensive operations in eastern Ukraine. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33734)
DeepState map update confirms Russian forces advanced near Tsvitkove in Donetsk/Zaporizhzhia area. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23882)
Russian strikes hit Kochetok electrical substation in Kharkiv region, part of systematic energy infrastructure targeting. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33729)
Russian forces employed Banderoil missiles and reactive UAVs against targets in Cherkasy region (Tsvitkove/Shpola) and Kirovohrad region (Nova Praha). (Source: @kpszsu/83069, @kpszsu/83092)
Russian jet-powered Shahed drones attacked industrial targets in Dnipropetrovsk region (Kryvyi Rih, Lykhivka) from southern and northern directions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76085, @eRadarrua/120300)

Russian Geran-5 missiles launched from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv region (Chernihiv district) and from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region (Vyshhorod district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76085, @mon1tor_ua/76074)
Russian Shahed drones launched from Sumy region toward Chernihiv region (Pryluky, Nizhyn districts) with 10 drones reported in one wave. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76064, @mon1tor_ua/76065)
Russian strike drone hit Berdychiv in Zhytomyr region, damaging residential building. (Source: @eRadarrua/120266)
Ukrainian defensive preparations in Kyiv region include 12 AI turrets and extensive barbed wire obstacles (35 rows) anticipating northern offensive. (Source: @UkraineNow/84488, @ukr_leaks_eng/33749)
Russian controlled jet Shahed drones maneuvered over Cherkasy region changing course toward Kyiv region (Obukhiv district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76074)
Russian strikes targeted port infrastructure: Vilkovo port facility, fuel storage at Chornomorsk port, and dry cargo ship in Odesa region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33729)
Russian Banderoil missile launched toward Nova Odesa in Mykolaiv region from southeast. (Source: @kpszsu/83066, @mon1tor_ua/76068)
Russian reactive UAVs detected in Berezivskyi district of Odesa region moving northwest, and over Mykolaiv region (Nova Praha, Kirovohrad). (Source: @kpszsu/83085, @kpszsu/83092)
Russian jet-powered Shahed drones attacked Mykolaiv and Odesa, with controlled drone circling over Odesa. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76085, @eRadarrua/120336)
Radiation check conducted after strike on industrial infrastructure in Odesa region; no hazardous substances detected. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33723)
